scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build:all: powershell -NoProfile -Command "cd backend; npm run build; cd ..\frontend; npm run build"
scripts.typecheck: powershell -NoProfile -Command "cd backend; npm run typecheck; cd ..\frontend; npm run typecheck"
scripts.test:all: powershell -NoProfile -Command "cd backend; npm run test; cd ..\frontend; npm run test"
